cases.case_label: SVA_F1 in SUZ12P1 intron 8 with 1-Mb atypical NF1 deletion (family of DA-77)
cases.mechanism_detail: A 5'-truncated ~1.7-kb copy of SVA_F1 source element H10_1 inserted into SUZ12P intron 8 by TPRT, and the insertion was coupled to a 1,001,546-bp deletion encompassing NF1 (ends joined by NHEJ). It arose postzygotically in the patient's grandmother (somatic mosaic, 75% deleted cells) and was transmitted to her offspring; position given is the proximal deletion breakpoint.
cases.quote: The SVA insertion and the associated atypical NF1 deletion had occurred de novo in the grandmother of patient DA-77 who exhibited somatic mosaicism with normal cells (Figures S18 and S19 in Additional file 1).

cases.case_label: SVA_F in SUZ12P1 intron 8 with 867-kb atypical NF1 deletion (ASB4-55)
cases.mechanism_detail: A de novo 5'-truncated ~1.3-kb SVA (copy of SVA_F source H6_1084) inserted into SUZ12P intron 8 together with an 866,769-bp deletion of the NF1 region; the patient is a somatic mosaic (93% of blood cells deleted). Position given is the proximal deletion breakpoint.
cases.quote: Remarkably, patient ASB4-55 also possessed a de novo insertion of a 5′ truncated SVA element at the breakpoints of the atypical NF1 deletion identified in this individual.
